items.escena: Close view of a clay computer motherboard with one empty square socket in the middle full of tiny pin holes, a small square clay processor chip hovering just above it ready to drop in
A clay computer motherboard with two long thin parallel slots, a long green clay memory stick with small black chips sliding down into one of the slots
An open clay computer case seen from the side showing an empty rectangular metal bay, a flat clay storage drive being slid into the bay by a clay hand
A clay motherboard with one long horizontal slot, a wide clay expansion card with a small fan being pushed down into the slot
A single square clay computer processor chip with a shiny metal top and a grid of tiny gold pins underneath, resting on a clay table
A long thin green clay memory stick with a row of small black rectangular chips and a gold contact edge along the bottom, lying on a clay table
A flat slim rectangular clay solid state drive in dark blue with a small label-free sticker area, lying on a clay table next to a tiny clay folder
A chunky clay graphics card with two round fans on its side and a small rainbow glow, lying on a clay table
A clay smartphone standing upright with its bright screen showing a colourful blank landscape wallpaper, a finger about to touch the glass
The back of a clay smartphone with a cluster of three round camera lenses and a small flash, a tiny clay flower in front of it being photographed
The bottom edge of a clay smartphone with a row of tiny microphone holes, small curved clay sound waves floating into them from a speaking clay mouth
A slim rectangular clay storage drive with a stack of tiny clay photos and folders flowing into it like a drawer being filled
A clay smartphone and a clay laptop side by side, both screens showing a neat grid of plain coloured app squares, as if the same organiser runs both devices
A clay smartphone showing a chat conversation made of rounded green and white speech bubbles without any text, a tiny clay paper plane flying out of it
A clay smartphone held sideways showing a video of a mountain landscape with a large rounded play triangle in the centre
A clay smartphone showing a calculator made of a grid of round coloured buttons, a clay finger pressing one of them
A small clay printer connected by a cable to a clay laptop, with a tiny clay translator figure in the middle of the cable passing a gear from one device to the other
A clay laptop whose screen shows a window with several rounded tabs at the top and a small clay globe of the Earth in the centre of the page
The physical parts of a computer spread on a clay table: a processor chip, a memory stick, a small fan, a cable and a screwdriver, everything you can touch
A clay laptop with glowing colourful app squares and small gears floating out of its screen like light, nothing physical in the air, only glowing shapes
